impacted.description:
The list of input types that are impacted by the updates to a series of {@link Sensor}s.

See types that mixin this type for more details.

notImpacted.description:
The list of input types that are not impacted by the updates to the {@link Sensor}s.
This is only if it was possible to fully confirm there was no impact.

See types that mixin this type for more details.

unverifiable.description:
The list of input types that had special cases for which it was not possible to validate
that the instance does or does not use the {@link Sensor}.

See types that mixin this type for more details.

impactedSensors.description: A list of relations of an input type to a list {@link Sensor} ids that the type contains.

name: FaultySensor.ImpactedBatchResult
